profile.headline: Solutions Architect / Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Entrepreneur, Instructor, and software development expert with over 20 years of experience building 
 technology solutions for clients in a wide variety of industries.

positions.title: Member
positions.description:
The ASPInsiders is a select group of international professionals who have a demonstrated expertise in ASP.NET technologies and who provide valuable, early feedback on related developing technologies and publications to their peers, the Microsoft ASP.NET team, and others.

http://aspinsiders.com

positions.title: Freelance Software Developer
positions.description: As the owner, and sole developer, of DoesNotCompile.com I’ve had the opportunity to work on many kinds of projects for a variety of clients and in several programming languages. This involves all aspects of software development and project management including interfacing with client to gather requirement, architecting solutions, demonstrate progress and coordinate releases. I’ve worked on everything from simple “mom and pop” websites to sophisticated applications that are used to audit commercial airlines, EMS, police and military flights.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description: We are a full service consulting company focused on helping our clients achieve their business objectives using the latest technologies, tools, and processes. We have decades of experience in all aspects of software development and have worked for clients of different sizes in a variety of industries. From marketing websites to enterprise applications, we have a team of experts that can help your organization with all of your software development needs.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: At Inventive Acadamy, we run a Full Stack Immersive Web Development Bootcamp teaching students at all levels of technical ability how to build modern, scalable web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node and React. As an instructor, I work with students in a group and individually to help them learn the technical aspects of building web applications as well as how to work in teams, build their personal brands manage their careers. As a co-founder, I am involved in all aspects of managing the business - marketing, sales, financing etc.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description: We are a full service consulting and training company specializing in: custom application development, software and team auditing, legacy and cloud migrations, IT Strategy, web and mobile development, continuous integration/continuous delivery, corporate training and full stack development bootcamps for people who want to learn to code and become software engineers.

positions.title: Cloud Architect
positions.description:
In my role as Cloud Architect for Volusion, I worked with the engineering team to come up with technical solution for all types of development projects. This involved doing the research to understand the problem, coming up with a technical design, creating API specifications and workflow diagrams when necessary, breaking out the solution into stories that can be worked on by the team and working with the engineering team to implement the solution. In addition to this, I helped define, and ensure that we properly implemented, the CI/CD pipeline for these projects. This includes tools for building, deploying, logging, auditing, monitoring and testing applications. I worked closely with the engineering team members to help improve their skill set and knowledge about software engineering tools, practices and processes. This included one on one working session, code reviews, general mentoring interactions and formal presentations.
In addition to my responsibilities as an architect, I was also responsible for developing applications in many different technologies to run on several different platforms. For example, I led the engineering team tasked with migrating the Volusion platform from our own infrastructure to the Google Cloud Platform. This involved updating some services, rewriting others, integrating with GCP services and developing new processes for the continuous integration and deployment of these applications in the Google Cloud Platform.

positions.title: Chief Architect
positions.description: At the Boon Group, I was responsible for the overall technical direction of the software development team. This included implementing a plan for upgrading existing application to use modern technologies, frameworks, processes and tools. I also worked with the development team to guarantee that their skill sets are up to date and inline with these technologies, frameworks, processes and tools. This included, among other things, having one on one mentoring sessions, peer programming, hosting "tech talks," and delivering reference implementations of the technologies that were new to the team.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: At Clear Measure, I led a team of 8 software developers working on the back-end RESTful API for a custom e-Reader application targeting K-12 students. The API was written using ASP.NET Web API 2, NServiceBus, SignalR, NHibernate and SQL Server. It was built and deployed to AWS, Azure and on premise servers using Psake, TeamCity and OctopusDeploy. My responsibilities included helping with business analysis, doing the technical analysis and test planing for all features, mentoring the team of developers, answering technical questions related to architecture, technology and technical design and doing code reviews as well as implementing features.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: At Revionics, I was part of the Portal team that was responsible for the web applications for all of the company’s products. For most of my time there, I was the lead developer on the API team for their new version of the Promotions Management product. That was a complete rewrite of the existing version and was implemented as a SPA (single page application) with a RESTful API back-end.

positions.title: Director of Software Development
positions.description: This position was a combination of software engineer, software architect, software development manager as well as project manager. My responsibilities included designing, developing, testing and maintaining features of the EnsembleVideo.com platform. I also managed all software development projects and releases. This included negotiating with the business side of the company for feature sets to include in releases as well as planning and scheduling all software development efforts. In addition to this, I managed and mentored all of the software developers.

positions.title: Technical Architect
positions.description: I was rehired by Perficient to work as part of their GreenDot engagement in Pasadena California. While on this project, I worked on a few proof of concept applications using NServiceBus, MSMQ and MSSQL ServiceBroker. I also did a lot of research for a project to upgrade their critical transaction detail table’s primary key and performed all of the necessary code changes to support this effort. In addition to this, I did some analysis of their existing MSSQL Server stored procedures, custom functions, SSIS packages and jobs in order to put together a Technical Design Document for rewriting a number of them as .NET applications. The end goal was that these critical business processes would be written is such a way that they can be better maintained, monitored, tested and reused.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Architect
positions.description: During my time at Dell, I have architected, developed and maintained several distributed and highly scalable enterprise applications including those used to import merchant catalogs, track leads and subsequent conversions, manage all of the data associated with creating stores on top of the imported merchant catalogs as well as the front end storefront application. I have also worked on the RESTful APIs for the storefront product catalogs and a separate content curation product that is being developed.

positions.title: Lead Technical Consultant
positions.description: After being hired on full time, I joined a team working on the administration tool and client facing portals of an affiliate marketplace application for Dell. While in this role, I worked many of the underlying system and tools that were used to manage the data that was utilized by the front end application. This included systems for generating e-mail and text message notifications, storing and serving images and other files and moderating user generated content.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: Was contracted through Technology Navigators to work for speakTech on a project for Dell to work on the devlopment of a reputation management system that was intended to run in the Azure Cloud environment. This system consumed activity information from external applications via a RESTful API and awarded points to those activities. Those points were then used to award badges that were associated with a user’s profile. All of this reputation information was then made visible via a RESTful API and javascript widgets that could be plugged in to external applications.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: After completing my contract through TekSystems, I was asked to join the Newgistics team as a permanent employee. My responsibilities were extended to include the support and extension of their Intellistation suite of tools used to generate labels, research packages/containers, generate quality samples and reports among other things. I also supported, maintained and upgraded the messaging systems that were used to communicate between software products deployed at the processing facilities around the country, the central processing system and all of our their clients. This includes a custom document processing system that consumes and generates XML, CSV, EDI and a few other file formats. I also was tasked with maintaining and troubleshooting BizTalk 2006 R2 custom maps, orchestrations and libraries.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: At Newgistics, I was brought in to help work on their new logistical systems to handle outbound packages. Newgistics was already processing returns and needed to expand their existing systems to process and route outgoing packages. Specifically, I was brought in to work on the label generation framework that would be used to render labels for all of their packages and containers in several different formats (ZPL II, PDF, GIF, JPG, PNG and BMP) and configurations. After having completed this, I was tasked with porting a lot of their legacy VB6 COM libraries over to C#. Later, I worked on enhancing their existing “advanced notification” subsystem so that it would generate and process the new messages associates with outbound packages.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: At BHI (BuilderHomeSite.com) I was brought in to work on the billing system that was used by the financial and sales department to collect information about all of the BHI clients and generate reports and invoices on a monthly basis. My first task was to convert the application from VB.NET 1.1 to C# 2.0. Then, I had to automate the generation of several Excel reports that were used to compile the information that would then be used to generate monthly invoices in the Microsoft Great Plains system. After this, I worked on adding tools for defining and maintaining the various products and fees that can be associated with a BHI client. Then, I used these items to define billing cycles and generate invoices that can be edited online by each account manager before they are submitted to Microsoft Great Plains. The invoice system includes auditing and approval systems that guarantee that all changes can be traced and must be approved by the appropriate users before they can be posted to the Microsoft Great Plains system or written out to Excel reports.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: At Wachovia I was part of the Internet Loan Services team, an Agile development group. In this position, I was responsible for the maintenance and enhancement of existing web applications as well as the development of new Web 2.0 applications. During my time here, I was able to work on several different types of applications including web services, database driven applications, a framework to generate PDF documents, build script, and test fixtures. I also led the conversion from Visual SourceSafe to CVSNT and was a major part of the conversion from Visual Studio 2005/ReSharper 3/.NET 2.0 to Visual Studio 2008/ReSharper 4/.NET 3.5.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: After being hired on at SWBC, I finished the .NET framework that was started while I was a contractor (see below) and worked with the rest of the development team to port about 10 different applications that are part of the SWBC’s FocusNet platform into .NET. At the same time, I continued to mentor the Delphi/Cobol developers in the C# programming.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: In this position, I was responsible for the development of new database driven desktop and web applications in .NET 2.0 as well as the migration of existing Delphi applications to .NET 2.0. During this time, I worked with another contractor to build the .NET framework that was being used to port all existing Delphi applications to .NET 2.0. I also helped mentor the existing Delphi/Cobol programmers in my department while they learned C# and the new framework that we were developing.

positions.title: Web Development Manager
positions.description: After 3 years of working for MySanAntonio.com, I was promoted to the Web Development Manager position. In that role I was responsible for 3 software developers, 2 web designers and a technical assistant. As their manager, I was in charge of hiring employees to fill these positions, evaluating their progress on a yearly basis and letting them go if they didn’t work out. I was also responsible for assigning tasks and making sure that they were completed on time and that they worked properly. In addition to this, I had to meet with our clients and partners to gather requirements and set expectations and deadlines. At the same time, I continued to design, develop and maintain the system, desktop and web applications that were used to populate and maintain the website.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: For my first 3 years at MySanAntonio.com, I was responsible for the design, development and maintenance of the software applications that were used to publish and maintain the MySanAntonio.com websites.  This included the automated applications that imported data from MySanAntonio.com partners and content providers, the applications that exported data to 3rd party companies that use it on their own websites, the web and desktop tools that were used to maintain all of the databases that MySanAntonio.com utilized on the website as well as the actual web pages that were accessible through www.mysanantonio.com and the other websites that MySanAntonio.com maintained.

Those points were then used to award badges that were associated with a user’s profile. All of this reputation information was then made visible via a RESTful API and javascript widgets that could be plugged in to external applications.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: After completing my contract through TekSystems, I was asked to join the Newgistics team as a permanent employee. My responsibilities were extended to include the support and extension of their Intellistation suite of tools used to generate labels, research packages/containers, generate quality samples and reports among other things. I also supported, maintained and upgraded the messaging systems that were used to communicate between software products deployed at the processing facilities around the country, the central processing system and all of our their clients. This includes a custom document processing system that consumes and generates XML, CSV, EDI and a few other file formats. I also was tasked with maintaining and troubleshooting BizTalk 2006 R2 custom maps, orchestrations and libraries.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: At Newgistics, I was brought in to help work on their new logistical systems to handle outbound packages. Newgistics was already processing returns and needed to expand their existing systems to process and route outgoing packages. Specifically, I was brought in to work on the label generation framework that would be used to render labels for all of their packages and containers in several different formats (ZPL II, PDF, GIF, JPG, PNG and BMP) and configurations. After having completed this, I was tasked with porting a lot of their legacy VB6 COM libraries over to C#. Later, I worked on enhancing their existing “advanced notification” subsystem so that it would generate and process the new messages associates with outbound packages.

experience.title: Senior .NET Developer
experience.description: At BHI (BuilderHomeSite.com) I was brought in to work on the billing system that was used by the financial and sales department to collect information about all of the BHI clients and generate reports and invoices on a monthly basis. My first task was to convert the application from VB.NET 1.1 to C# 2.0. Then, I had to automate the generation of several Excel reports that were used to compile the information that would then be used to generate monthly invoices in the Microsoft Great Plains system. After this, I worked on adding tools for defining and maintaining the various products and fees that can be associated with a BHI client. Then, I used these items to define billing cycles and generate invoices that can be edited online by each account manager before they are submitted to Microsoft Great Plains. The invoice system includes auditing and approval systems that guarantee that all changes can be traced and must be approved by the appropriate users before they can be posted to the Microsoft Great Plains system or written out to Excel reports.

experience.title: Senior .NET Developer
experience.description: At Wachovia I was part of the Internet Loan Services team, an Agile development group. In this position, I was responsible for the maintenance and enhancement of existing web applications as well as the development of new Web 2.0 applications. During my time here, I was able to work on several different types of applications including web services, database driven applications, a framework to generate PDF documents, build script, and test fixtures. I also led the conversion from Visual SourceSafe to CVSNT and was a major part of the conversion from Visual Studio 2005/ReSharper 3/.NET 2.0 to Visual Studio 2008/ReSharper 4/.NET 3.5.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: After being hired on at SWBC, I finished the .NET framework that was started while I was a contractor (see below) and worked with the rest of the development team to port about 10 different applications that are part of the SWBC’s FocusNet platform into .NET. At the same time, I continued to mentor the Delphi/Cobol developers in the C# programming.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description: In this position, I was responsible for the development of new database driven desktop and web applications in .NET 2.0 as well as the migration of existing Delphi applications to .NET 2.0. During this time, I worked with another contractor to build the .NET framework that was being used to port all existing Delphi applications to .NET 2.0. I also helped mentor the existing Delphi/Cobol programmers in my department while they learned C# and the new framework that we were developing.

positions.title: Web Development Manager
positions.description: After 3 years of working for MySanAntonio.com, I was promoted to the Web Development Manager position. In that role I was responsible for 3 software developers, 2 web designers and a technical assistant. As their manager, I was in charge of hiring employees to fill these positions, evaluating their progress on a yearly basis and letting them go if they didn’t work out. I was also responsible for assigning tasks and making sure that they were completed on time and that they worked properly. In addition to this, I had to meet with our clients and partners to gather requirements and set expectations and deadlines. At the same time, I continued to design, develop and maintain the system, desktop and web applications that were used to populate and maintain the website.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: For my first 3 years at MySanAntonio.com, I was responsible for the design, development and maintenance of the software applications that were used to publish and maintain the MySanAntonio.com websites.  This included the automated applications that imported data from MySanAntonio.com partners and content providers, the applications that exported data to 3rd party companies that use it on their own websites, the web and desktop tools that were used to maintain all of the databases that MySanAntonio.com utilized on the website as well as the actual web pages that were accessible through www.mysanantonio.com and the other websites that MySanAntonio.com maintained.
